slides.teacher_cue: New sound. Relax your mouth completely. Tongue in the middle of the mouth, mid-height. Lips neutral — not rounded, not spread. Short and unstressed — uh.

slides.observation_note: Watch for lip rounding — /ʌ/ has no rounding. Korean learners may substitute /a/ (as in bag). Monitor from this lesson.
